name: Tooltip
blurb: A short label that appears on hover or focus.
mechanism: The text is a `data-tip` attribute and the bubble is `::after`, so there is no extra element to place or keep in sync. It is shown on `:hover` and on `:focus-visible`, and the arrow is `::before`.
caveats: A pseudo-element cannot be referenced by `aria-describedby` — the words have to be repeated in `aria-label`, which is why the markup says them twice.
The bubble is clipped by any ancestor with `overflow: hidden`, and it cannot escape one. A tooltip inside a scrolling panel needs a real element and an anchor.
Touch has no hover. The tooltip never appears on a phone, so it must never carry the only copy of something a user needs.
